summary: Route GitHub observer reads through operator-supplied per-owner installation tokens while preserving PAT writes and legacy statuses

replay.detail: No graph replay or observer cursor migration. Existing opaque identity records select Issue versus PR authorization.

schema.detail: No database schema or replication changes.

compatibility.detail: Optional github.app_token_root or ST3_GITHUB_APP_TOKEN_ROOT selects gh-ci and github-ledger read tokens by repository owner. Without a supplied root reads continue using PAT. Writes always retain the existing Local/Authorized PAT route. Mixed identity pages now use separate Issue and PR queries. App PR rollups merge PAT-only combined legacy commit statuses because neither app has statuses:read. Cache identities include stable authorization scope rather than secrets.

downtime.detail: Only normal daemon upgrade/restart; no daemon restart is performed by this change.

manual.detail: Operator supplies an absolute minter root; st3 never computes platform paths. External minter atomically publishes owner mode0600 bare token files and installation_id/expires_at/permissions/repository_selection JSON sidecars, refreshing below15minutes of a60-minute lifetime. Watch st.github.auth.fallback by owner/app/reason; remove transition fallback after one week of zero unintentional fallback, treating the documented statuses exception separately. The minter is not deployed by this change.

recovery.detail: Missing, absent-installation, expired, unreadable/invalid and401 installation reads use an observable transition PAT fallback. A401 permits a bounded read reload/replay; writes are never replayed or app-authorized. Remove the optional root to restore PAT-only reads. No live credentials, state or installation permissions are changed.
